data.title: Apple Trained Own AI model for China Market With Help From Alibaba
data.description: Reuters reports that Apple has trained its own large language model for the China market, rather than relying on a third-party model to power its Apple Intelligence features in the country. The LLM has been developed with the help of Alibaba, according to the report's sources. The development marks a break from Apple's previous strategy of relying on domestic models to bring generative AI to its devices sold in China. Rollout of its AI features in China is expected in the coming months.
